name: Flow assurance simulation
principle: Transient multiphase simulators predict slugging, hydrate and wax risk, cooldown and start-up behaviour of wells, flowlines and risers. The SLB OLGA page read describes it only as the industry-standard dynamic multiphase simulator, with no figures.
advantages: Avoids over-design of insulation and chemicals

sources.note: SLB, OLGA dynamic multiphase flow simulator page, read 25 October 2026 (descriptive only)
